weekTheme: Integrating AI Without Losing Your Soul
hook: 5 places AI belongs in your organization's marketing — and 3 places it never should.
direction: Belongs: research, first drafts, repurposing sermons/content into posts, data analysis, testing variants. Never: pastoral or donor correspondence, your final voice, anything published without human review. Carousel.

facebook.text:
5 places AI belongs in your organization's marketing — and 3 places it never should.

Belongs:
1. Research — finding what your audience is actually asking
2. First drafts — getting words on the page faster
3. Repurposing sermons or long content into social posts
4. Data analysis — spotting what's working
5. Testing variants — subject lines, headlines, calls to action

Never:
1. Pastoral or donor correspondence — those relationships require a real person
2. Your final voice — AI doesn't know your mission the way you do
3. Anything published without a human reading it first

AI is a capable assistant. It is not a steward of your organization's trust.

posts: AI belongs in your research, first drafts, content repurposing, data analysis, and variant testing. It does not belong in donor letters, pastoral care, or anything that goes out without a human reading it first.

cover.title: AI: Where It Helps. Where It Doesn't.
cover.subtitle: 5 places it belongs. 3 places it never should.

slides.title: ✓ Research
slides.body: Use AI to find what your audience is searching for and asking. It surfaces patterns faster than manual digging.

slides.title: ✓ First Drafts
slides.body: AI gets words on the page. Your team shapes them into something true to your voice and mission.

slides.title: ✓ Repurposing Content
slides.body: Turn a sermon, report, or long article into social posts, emails, or summaries — without starting from scratch.

slides.title: ✓ Data & Testing
slides.body: Analyze what's working. Test subject lines and headlines. Let AI handle the numbers so you can act on them.

slides.title: ✗ Donor & Pastoral Correspondence
slides.body: These relationships run on trust. A real person must write them. Every time.

slides.title: ✗ Your Final Voice
slides.body: AI doesn't carry your history, your values, or your calling. It can draft. It cannot speak for you.

slides.title: ✗ Anything Unreviewed
slides.body: Nothing goes out without a human reading it first. That's not a suggestion — it's stewardship.

end.title: AI is a tool. You are the steward.
end.subtitle: Bequest Digital — built for mission-driven organizations.
